description: Read distilled wiki pages from a WIKI compilation. Pass a slug to fetch one full page (markdown body + citations); omit the slug to list all pages (optionally filtered by query).

query.description: Optional: when no slug is given, filter the listed pages whose title contains this text.

slug.description: Slug of a specific page to fetch (e.g. "fabio-chiaramonte"). Omit to list all pages.

name: gctrl_wiki_page
